Barrier

Version

15.25.3a4a52
June 16, 2026
Vocation Adjustments 2026

Status

Active
A Barrier, introduced with Vocation Adjustments 2026, is a way to protect Druids and Sorcerers from lethal damage. When incoming damage would exceed their current HP, the character is set to 1 HP and the remaining damage is converted into mana damage with a 10x multiplier. Additionaly, 25% of the character's maximum mana is consumed, but this additional mana consumption can only trigger once every 2 seconds. If there is not enough mana to absorb the converted damage, the character dies.

There is no cooldown for this effect, as long as the character has enough mana to block lethal attacks, the damage will keep draining their mana. The Server Log shows when the effect was activated: You lose 296 mana due to an attack by a gang member. (Mana Buffer).

History

  • On July 10, 2026, the mana hit multiplier was raised from 8x to 10x.
